interpretation.public: HTTP metrics exclude warm-up. Financial, supplier and ACK totals include warm-up and drain. An empty queue alone does not establish valid settlement. The window intersection is checked independently using matching HTTP and confirmed ACK identities.
interpretation.direct: No public HTTP, provider, plugin, or external ACK is measured. Timely grant and durable publication are counted by request deadline. Exact customer and supplier settlement is checked after drain.
interpretation.sse: The short diagnostic does not compute the minute intersection. DONE counts a parsed terminal frame; validated HTTP completion also requires a valid body and transport completion. Compare artifacts by hash before attributing fast/paced differences.
